_about: 3D Director (law 32, owner 2026-11-14: "art director, video director … in 3D … we are going to name it as 3D Director"; "when we are going to generate any particular scenes … we have to use this [our shot method]"). Our 3D shot types as studios. One entry = one studio card on the 3D Director page; `studio ddirect "<owner's words>"` picks the studio, `studio shot <id> <scene.blend|--text WORD>` builds it with tools/blender/shots.py on top of a finished model (law 30's six steps first) and renders it to 3D · Scenes, tagged with the studio (its own gallery under 3D Director). status: ready = `studio shot` builds it now · partial = runs with limits (see note) · none = recipe known, not built yet (build when the owner asks). source = the shot it is based on.

studios.label: Packshot
studios.what: One clean hero still: big soft key, two strip lights for edge highlights, kicker, dark cyclorama.

studios.label: Turntable
studios.what: The product turns on its own axis under fixed studio light; camera still, every side shown.
studios.source: 2B camera orbit around the car (inverted: product turns)

studios.label: Hero Orbit
studios.what: Low three-quarter hero angle, camera arcs around the product on a wet dark floor with strip reflections.
studios.source: 2F hero low 3/4 on wet floor, strip-light reflections

studios.label: Exploded Assembly
studios.what: Parts float apart in an exploded view, then slam together one by one with a small overshoot.
studios.source: 2B exploded-view car, parts slam together on the beat
studios.note: needs a model built from separate parts (each part its own object); a one-piece mesh has nothing to explode

studios.label: Light Sweep Reveal
studios.what: Out of darkness: a light strip sweeps across the product, the lights fade up, slow push-in.
studios.source: 1A light sweep across brass teeth out of darkness · 6A title sweep

studios.label: Macro Detail
studios.what: Razor-thin focus close to the surface; slow lateral dolly with a rack focus from near to far.
studios.source: 1C balance wheel macro · 1D lateral dolly across a gear train with rack focus

studios.label: FPV Fly-through
studios.what: A drone flight threading through a mechanism or a space, banking hard, ending head-on on the hero.
studios.source: 1E FPV through the clockwork · 3H slot-canyon chase

studios.label: Light Shafts
studios.what: A thin local haze volume so a light draws a visible shaft; blacks stay black.
studios.source: K.haze local noisy haze box lit from the side · vol_only lights

studios.label: Dark Studio
studios.what: A dark concrete studio: wet reflective floor with puddles, cool LED strips, a warm doorway glow.
studios.source: Act II studio (2A–2F): wet floor, linear strips, warm door spill

studios.label: Dusk Exterior
studios.what: Low golden sun (3–6°), teal upper sky, warm horizon haze, rust-red rock.
studios.note: sky + light ready in the kit; no terrain generator yet — build when asked

studios.label: Brass Title
studios.what: A word or brand name in machined brass, bevelled edges, revealed by a light sweep crossing the letters.
studios.source: a title word in machined brass, light sweep, to black

studios.label: Dust in the Light
studios.what: A few tiny dust motes drifting through the light, mostly out of focus — never glowing sparkles.
studios.source: client rule: effects must look real · act1 motes

studios.label: Hot Sparks
studios.what: Few, short hot-metal sparks: white-yellow core cooling to orange, gravity, bounce, motion blur.

studios.label: Disintegrate
studios.what: A surface breaks into real material chunks that blow away, revealing what is behind.
